def evolved_p88(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i, j] = i XOR j. Vectorized bit decomposition.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    nbits = 1
    while (1 << nbits) < N:
        nbits += 1
    powers = torch.tensor([1 << k for k in range(nbits)], device=x.device)
    ai = (idx.view(N, 1, 1) // powers) % 2
    aj = (idx.view(1, N, 1) // powers) % 2
    res = (((ai + aj) % 2) * powers).sum(-1)
    return res.to(x.dtype)
